approach: Client half is greenfield in a new self-contained packages/studio/src/crash/ directory whose import graph must never reach @keyboard-studio/engine, gated by a new import-graph test. Server half copies the managed-PR quartet (schema/pipeline/adapter/Fastify mirror) under utilities/oauth-backend plus a separate CRASH_REPORT_APP_* token minter, computing the dedupe fingerprint server-side from raw client inputs so no caller-supplied value can redirect a report. A new Vite define surfaces VERCEL_GIT_COMMIT_SHA as a compile-time build id readable pre-mount.

decisions.decision: Crash code lives in a new top-level packages/studio/src/crash/ directory
decisions.why: Lets the FR-013 import-graph gate be defined as every file in this directory is an entry point, which stays correct as files are added
decisions.rejected: Scattering crash*.ts through src/lib/, which would force the gate onto a hand-maintained file list that silently goes stale

decisions.decision: FR-124 accessibility coverage splits across two lanes: axe scan in Playwright, structural ARIA/focus assertions in vitest
decisions.why: expectNoSeriousAxeViolations does not exist in code -- it appears only in specs/** prose. The sole axe dependency is @axe-core/playwright and the studio jsdom/vitest lane has no axe integration, as StudioFooter.a11y.test.tsx states in its header
decisions.rejected: Adding jest-axe to the vitest lane, which is a separate change and creates a second competing axe surface

decisions.decision: A new crash-report-installation-token.ts with its own module-scope auth cache, duplicating ~60 lines of installation-token.ts
decisions.why: installation-token.ts memoizes createAppAuth in a module-level _auth keyed to nothing, so a shared minter would hand whichever App loaded first to both pipelines -- defeating the P0-2 credential separation mechanically, not just conceptually
decisions.rejected: Parameterizing getInstallationToken(appVars) and calling it from both pipelines

decisions.decision: One pure canonicalizeCrashInput() with a framesFromRawStack() adapter, so structured stackFrames[] and raw stack normalize to the same shape before hashing
decisions.why: SC-019 requires a V8-shaped and a Firefox/Safari-shaped stack for the same error to produce an identical fingerprint; one code path makes that true by construction rather than by two implementations agreeing
decisions.rejected: Separate canonicalizeStructured/canonicalizeRaw functions, which is exactly how the two paths drift and fork one bug into two issues

decisions.decision: Client and server implement the FR-081a algorithm independently, both pinned to the FR-081d worked example
decisions.why: No sharable home exists -- the client cannot value-import a workspace package (FR-010 graph constraint) and the server cannot either (bundle safety), so specification-level agreement plus a shared fixture is the only mechanism. FR-022 already establishes nothing depends on the two agreeing

decisions.decision: Send result reaches the UI via a module-scope subscribable consumed with useSyncExternalStore, not a zustand store
decisions.why: Two of the three capture surfaces fire outside any React tree and the POST resolves after the fallback has already rendered; a zustand store would live under src/stores/ where the engine-importing modules are, crossing the FR-012 boundary
decisions.rejected: Threading the send promise through the ErrorBoundary state, which the window-level handlers have no boundary to reach

decisions.decision: The /report/crash rewrite is inserted above the terminal /(.*) catch-all in vercel.json
decisions.why: Vercel evaluates rewrites in order and the catch-all matches everything; a rewrite appended after it is dead config whose failure is silent -- the endpoint would return index.html with a 200 and the fire-and-forget POST would report success while filing nothing
decisions.rejected: Appending the rewrite, which is the obvious wrong instinct

decisions.decision: Extended CrashReportBodySchema.context to the full FR-040 structural set (keyboardId, bcp47Tags, stepId, keyCount, exemplarCount, decisionTail, breadcrumbs) alongside browserUA/os
decisions.why: contracts/crash-report-api.md declares only browserUA and os under context; zod strips unknown keys, so the FR-040 structural context the filed issue is required to carry would have been silently dropped, making FR-040/FR-046 unsatisfiable
decisions.rejected: Following the contract table literally and passing structural context through a second top-level field

decisions.why: FR-122 pins exactly six crash.* message ids and FR-126 forbids repurposing an existing one; a reload control has no id, and FR-072 requires only that controls which exist are real keyboard-operable elements
decisions.rejected: Reusing crash.report.retry.notice as the reload label

decisions.decision: The reopen cooldown is keyed on the presence of the regression label, not on updated_at alone
decisions.why: FR-095 (first hit after a close always reopens) and FR-095a (a repeat inside the cooldown is suppressed) contradict each other if only updated_at is read, because a maintainer closing an issue sets updated_at to now and would put the very next recurrence inside the cooldown. The regression label is the stateless record of we already reopened this, so it separates the signal from the churn.
decisions.rejected: Reading updated_at alone, which drops the first regression report after every close

decisions.decision: Added POST /report/crash/retract as a separate route, plus an optional commentId on the report response
decisions.why: contracts/crash-report-api.md lists the GitHub-side retraction calls but defines no client-facing route for them, so FR-074-FR-077 had no way to reach the server; and a commented report cannot be retracted without the client being told which comment is its own
decisions.rejected: A mode flag on the report body, which would make required fields depend on the flag and leave message meaningless for a retraction

plan.summary: plan.md + research.md (10 decisions) + data-model.md + contracts/ (crash-report-api.md, client-surface.md); Constitution Check PASS on all eight Articles, no violations
plan.key_finding: expectNoSeriousAxeViolations, which FR-124 cites as an existing helper, does not exist in code -- axe is Playwright-only here, so the accessibility requirement has to split across two test lanes or it gets silently half-satisfied

tasks.summary: 58 tasks across 9 phases (Setup, Foundational, US1-US6, Polish) laid out as 24 waves with explicit join points; 112 requirements mapped to tasks
tasks.key_finding: The FR-013 import-graph gate is placed first in Foundational rather than in its own US4 phase, so every crash-module file is written against a live constraint instead of audited afterwards

implement.summary: Crash reporting end to end: self-contained client crash module behind a demonstrated-red import gate, server-authoritative fingerprinting and dedupe on a second GitHub App, stale-deploy carve-out, pre-mount path, and undo.
